claims.claim: American used Nikon D750 Body, clean and pure as new, working perfectly.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show Nikon-branded packaging and a Nikon camera with a long lens on top of boxes, but the exact model (D750) and working condition (autofocus/zoom/buttons/sensor) are not readable or tested in the photos.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (photos do not show the D750 model/series clearly).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera’s model name/number on the body (e.g., on the top plate or inside the battery compartment) and/or the box label matching the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Nikon DSLR body/kit with unknown model and unknown specs.

risks.risk: Not actually a 'body only' sale (photos show a long lens and bracket/rig; included lens/accessories may differ).
risks.proof: A photo showing everything included laid out (camera body, lens model, battery, charger, strap, hood, cables) with labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: camera body with uncertain/possibly missing accessories and uncertain lens inclusion.

risks.risk: Condition issues (scratches, dents, worn mounts, dust/fungus/haze on lens, sensor dust).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: lens front element (against light), lens rear element, camera sensor (at least a test shot showing dust), and the exterior for scratches/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-fully-verified condition (possible cosmetic wear and possible dust), not 'as new'.

risks.risk: Working status not proven (autofocus, shutter count/usage, buttons/ports, stabilization, viewfinder/EVF).
risks.proof: A short video test: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, zoom/controls response (if lens present), and a quick shutter actuation sequence; include a screen showing settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/unknown working' until functional tests are shown.

risks.risk: Battery/charger compatibility and completeness (battery type, charger, cables may be missing or non-original).
risks.proof: Photos of the exact battery model label, charger model label, and all included cables/strap/hood/manuals with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (missing or non-original accessories possible).

risks.risk: Authenticity/warranty/receipt not verifiable from photos (risk of refurbished/gray-market/borrowed packaging).
risks.proof: Photos of the receipt/warranty card (if any) and serial number on the camera body; also a clear photo of the box label/serial match.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no warranty/receipt verification available.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera body showing the exact model (D750) and serial number.
Photo of the box label text that matches the camera model/serial.
Lay-out photo of all included items (camera, lens model, battery, charger, strap, hood, cables, manuals) with labels visible.
Close-up photos of lens front/rear elements and camera exterior for scratches/dents.
Sensor dust check: photo of sensor or a test image showing dust spots.
Short video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, and button/port responsiveness.
response.reason: The witness confirms Nikon-branded packaging and a Nikon camera with a long lens, but the exact D750 model and working condition cannot be verified from the provided photos. Without a readable model and functional proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
